name: bitbucket_pipelines
description: Shows the Bitbucket pipelines of one repository: the recent runs; with build_number, that run's steps, and with step also the last 150 lines of that step's log (credentials hidden); with options=true, the pipelines that can be run on a branch. Use it when the user asks how a build or deploy went, why it failed, or what can be deployed, and to follow a run after bitbucket_run_pipeline. It changes nothing. Returns one line per run (#build | state | ref | selector | commit | duration | creator), per step, or per log line.

repo.description: Repository slug, as bitbucket_repos shows it (e.g. api-orders).

ref.description: Branch to filter the runs by, or to read the options from (e.g. main). Leave it out for all runs, or for the main branch.

build_number.description: Run number to show in detail, as #build in the list (e.g. 482).

step.description: With build_number: the step's index or name whose log to read (e.g. 2 or Deploy).

grep.description: With step: keep only log lines containing this text, any case (e.g. error).

options.description: true to list the pipelines that can be run on ref, instead of the recent runs.
